title: CR-C2-031 — Portal + customer lookup
preconds: Permissions (counted): Customer Portal + Customers V. View Mode: Full unless noted. All other permissions OFF.
steps:
1. Create a custom role with the permissions listed in Preconditions; leave all others OFF.
  2. Assign the role to a test user and log in.
  3. Exercise each capability in Expected Result and confirm it succeeds (and that gated pricing is hidden where noted).
expected:
User CAN: Manage customer portal; view customer records

Risk / Rationale: Positive capability check — confirms this combination grants exactly the listed actions and nothing gated leaks.
Spec Ref: §2b+§1d
